topics.title: Articles
topics.description: Rules and examples for a, an and the

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He saw an owl in the tree. She is an honest girl.

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He is a teacher. She bought a university bag. (Note: "University" starts with a consonant sound /juː/)

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Before a certain or specific unidentified thing

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: I saw a certain bird flying high. A certain man was looking for you.

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: A servant must obey his master. Anyone can become a leader.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: No article before names of people

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: I met Ahmed yesterday. Fatima is my sister.

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: Gold is a precious metal. Iron is used in construction.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: No article before titles (when used with names)

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: President Lincoln abolished slavery. Doctor Ali is on leave today.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: No article before cities and countries (general rule)

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: I live in Multan. He visited Pakistan last year.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: No article before abstract nouns (general idea)

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: Honesty is the best policy. Love conquers all.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: No article before common diseases (except a few)

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He is suffering from malaria. She has diabetes.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Exceptions: article the is used with measles, mumps

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He caught the measles last month. She was diagnosed with the mumps.

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: Man is mortal. Woman has always played a vital role.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: No article before hell, heaven, or God (used reverently)

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He hopes to go to heaven. We must fear God.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Exception: article the is used with "devil"

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: The moon looks beautiful tonight. The sun rises in the east.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Use the with countries having "States", "Kingdom", or plurals

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He visited the United States. She works in the Netherlands.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Use the with provinces, mountain ranges, rivers, oceans

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He lives in the Punjab. They climbed the Himalayas. We swam in the Atlantic Ocean.

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: The United Nations passed a new resolution. The World Bank approved the loan.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Use the when speaking of a known person or thing

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: The man you saw was my teacher. The pen on the desk is mine.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Use the with names of famous books

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He read The Quran daily. She studied The Republic by Plato.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Use the with a class of animals, birds, or objects

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: The lion is a dangerous animal. The eagle soars high. The computer has changed the world.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Use the with a class of people

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: The rich must help the poor. The elderly need care.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: Use the with books, journals, and buildings

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: I visited the Eiffel Tower. He reads the Economist every week. She works in the Parliament House.

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He is the best player on the team.

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: She was the first to arrive.

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: I read the Dawn every morning.

fields.label: Rule
fields.value: With proper nouns used in a descriptive sense

fields.label: Example Sentence
fields.value: He is the Shakespeare of our times.

fields.label: Definition
fields.value: A group of words that contains a subject and a verb. It may or may not express a complete thought.

fields.label: Types
fields.value: 1. Independent Clause - expresses a complete thought 2. Dependent Clause - does not express a complete thought

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Independent Clause: She went to school. Dependent Clause: Because she was late.

fields.label: Definition
fields.value: A group of words that does not have both a subject and a complete verb. Some phrases (like verb phrases) do include verbs, but not a complete clause.

fields.label: Types
fields.value: 1. Noun Phrase - acts as a noun 2. Verb Phrase - main verb + helping verbs (but no subject) 3. Prepositional Phrase - begins with a preposition 4. Adjective Phrase - modifies a noun 5. Adverb Phrase - modifies a verb, adjective, or adverb

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Noun Phrase: A beautiful dress Verb Phrase: has been working (but no subject) Prepositional Phrase: in the morning Adjective Phrase: full of energy Adverb Phrase: in a polite manner

fields.label: Definition / Explanation
fields.value: A sentence with only one independent clause. It expresses a complete thought.

fields.label: Definition / Explanation
fields.value: A sentence with two or more independent clauses, joined by a coordinating conjunction, conjunctive adverb, or semicolon.

fields.label: Example
fields.value: A. He studied, and he passed. B. He studied; therefore, he passed. C. He studied; he passed.

fields.label: Definition / Explanation
fields.value: A sentence with one independent clause and one or more dependent clauses.

fields.label: Clause Structure
fields.value: One Independent Clause + One or More Dependent Clauses

fields.label: Example
fields.value: A. When it rained, we stayed inside. B. We stayed inside when it rained. C. My car, which is red, is fast. D. The man who called is my friend.

fields.label: Definition / Explanation
fields.value: A sentence that has two or I more independent clauses and at least one dependent clause.

fields.label: Clause Structure
fields.value: Two or More ndependent Clauses + One or More Dependent Clauses

fields.label: Example
fields.value: Although it rained, we went outside, and we enjoyed the walk.

fields.label: Explanation / Usage
fields.value: Join two independent clauses in compound sentences

fields.label: Structure Pattern
fields.value: Independent clause, coordinating conjunction, independent clause

fields.label: Example
fields.value: He plays cricket, and she plays football.

fields.label: Explanation / Usage
fields.value: Join two independent clauses, showing relationship (cause, contrast, result, etc.)

fields.label: Structure Pattern
fields.value: Independent clause; conjunctive adverb, independent clause

fields.label: Example
fields.value: He was late; however, he completed the task.

fields.label: Explanation / Usage
fields.value: Introduce a dependent clause in complex sentences

fields.label: Structure Pattern
fields.value: Dependent clause, independent clause or Independent clause dependent clause

fields.label: Example
fields.value: Because he was ill, he stayed home. He stayed home because he was ill.

fields.label: Explanation / Usage
fields.value: Introduce a dependent clause describing a noun

fields.label: Structure Pattern
